rules.note: The CCP National Congress meets every five years. The first plenary session of the new Central Committee, held straight after it, elects the General Secretary, the Politburo and its Standing Committee. The anchor is the 20th Central Committee's first plenary session.

The first session of each new National People's Congress elects the President for five years; the NPC Presidium has always nominated a single candidate. NPC deputies are themselves chosen indirectly by provincial-level congresses, so no direct national legislative election is modelled.

historical.note: The 16th National Congress sat 8-14 November 2002 with 2,114 delegates. The first plenary session of the 16th Central Committee elected Hu Jintao General Secretary on 15 November 2002, succeeding Jiang Zemin. The date is the day of that election.

historical.note: The 18th National Congress sat 8-14 November 2012 with 2,268 delegates. Xi Jinping became General Secretary on 15 November 2012, at the first plenary session of the 18th Central Committee. The Politburo Standing Committee shrank from nine to seven members.
